designationHistory.indexText: Established on December 1, 1997, to protect tidal freshwater marsh, old rice fields and floodplain forest along the Waccamaw, Great Pee Dee and Little Pee Dee rivers.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page does not say how it was established.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Waccamaw National Wildlife Refuge was established on December 1, 1997 and consists of wetland habitats ranging from historic, broken and actively managed tidal rice fields, to black water and alluvial flood plain forested wetlands of the Waccamaw and Great Pee Dee Rivers.
